content.text: The `SessionCard` status badge is rendered in Line 1 of `packages/client/src/components/session/SessionCard.tsx` as a status chip containing the source icon and an overlaid `StatusShapeBadge`, with its color derived in `packages/client/src/lib/session/session-status-visuals.ts`. ### Exact Files - **Rendering**: `packages/client/src/components/session/SessionCard.tsx` - **Color and shape derivation**: `packages/client/src/lib/session/session-status-visuals.ts` - **Theme color tokens**: `packages/client/src/lib/theme/themes.ts` and `packages/client/src/index.css` --- ### Where It Is Rendered In `packages/client/src/components/session/SessionCard.tsx`: - **Desktop view** (lines 846–854): ```tsx ``` - **Mobile view** (lines 683–691): ```tsx ``` - **`StatusShapeBadge`** definition (lines 119–131): Renders the shape glyph icon (`statusShapeIcon[shape]`) in an absolute corner badge using `colorClass` (`iconStatusColor`). --- ### How Its Color Is Chosen The color is derived in two steps: 1. **`deriveDotColorWithFlags(session, flags)`** in `packages/client/src/lib/session/session-status-visuals.ts` (lines 100–111) computes the base background token by strict precedence: - `flags.hasError` → `"bg-[var(--status-error)]"` - `isChatRoutedAskUser(session, flags.hasWidgetBarPrompt)` (`currentTool === "ask_user"` when alive and not in a widget bar) → `"bg-[var(--status-needs-you)]"` - `session.resuming` → `"bg-[var(--status-working)] animate-pulse"` - `flags.isRetrying` → `"bg-[var(--status-working)] animate-pulse"` - `flags.hasNotice` → `"bg-[var(--status-notice)]"` - `statusColors[session.status]` map: - `streaming` → `"bg-[var(--status-working)] animate-pulse"` - `active` / `idle` → `"bg-[var(--status-idle)]"` - `ended` → `"bg-[var(--bg-surface)]"` - fallback → `"bg-[var(--bg-surface)]"` 2. **`deriveIconStatusColor(dotColor, status)`** in `packages/client/src/lib/session/session-status-visuals.ts` (lines 124–135) transforms the background class into text color: - If `status === "ended"` and `dotColor` starts with `"bg-[var(--bg-surface)]"`, it returns `"text-[var(--text-muted)]"`. - Otherwise, it replaces the leading `bg-` prefix with `text-` (e.g. `"text-[var(--status-working)] animate-pulse"`), which colors the icon and shape badge. Theme CSS variables (`--status-needs-you`, `--status-working`, `--status-idle`, `--status-error`, `--status-notice`) resolve in `packages/client/src/lib/theme/themes.ts` to `--accent-purple`, `--accent-yellow`, `--accent-green`, `--accent-red`, and `--accent-blue`.
